recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-30514; any future uri/canonical search semantics work should be handled separately from this resolved _profile type correction.
issue_request: FHIR-30514 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that the standard _profile search parameter be marked as reference everywhere, resolving a mismatch where the Resource search listing showed uri while the Search page listed reference.
initial_application: The issue was applied in two source-history steps: a1cf2cf018130744adb32d8d92f03de8e16f1a93 changed the search.html common-parameters summary row from uri to reference, and 6d75b061edb768cac1c186923ab8cd4510c2f42f (Fix FHIR-30514) changed source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml from uri to reference for Resource-_profile.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2021-02-22 record the persuasive 12-0-0 motion. Related FHIR-33203 was later Resolved - No Change/Retracted after confirming the FHIR-30514 _profile bullet was applied by PR #1377; its remaining uri/canonical search requests were outside FHIR-30514.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml currently has <type value="reference"/> for Resource-_profile, and source/search.html both states that _profile is a reference parameter and lists it as reference in the common search-parameter table.

related_jiras.note: Follow-up report that _profile still appeared as uri on the Resource page; it was retracted after PR #1377 confirmed FHIR-30514 was applied, while its other requests were out of scope.
